deviations.what: nvsh setup also detects missing helper tools (uv, tmux; pi via npm) and offers to install them; on confirmation setup runs the install itself (apt/snap/npm), so orin gets uv and tmux from the setup flow instead of manual steps
deviations.reason: operator request during wave 5 (2026-09-13): orin has no uv and no tmux; thor has npm but no pi; the plan's setup only printed the pi offer

deviations.what: t19 verification: under Ghostty, bash-preexec (sourced by ghostty.bash) always places __bp_precmd_invoke_cmd ahead of __nvsh_hook, so the 'nvsh first in PROMPT_COMMAND' criterion cannot hold there and PIPESTATUS reaches the hook as a single element (false | true -> 0). Fix: __nvsh_hook reads BP_PIPESTATUS when bash-preexec ran first (it preserves $? and exposes the copy); the t19 criterion becomes 'nvsh hook present once, and pipeline PIPESTATUS correct with and without bash-preexec'
deviations.reason:
measured on spark with a copy of the real rc: declare -p PROMPT_COMMAND=[0]=$'__bp_precmd_invoke_cmd
__nvsh_hook
__fig_post_prompt
__bp_interactive_mode'; NVSH_HOOK_DEBUG_FILE shows 0<TAB>0 for 'false | true'

deviations.what: v1: under Ghostty the failing command's 133;D arrives after __nvsh_hook runs, so capture._locate_last_region falls back to the previous command's C..D region and the agent diagnoses the wrong output; fix: treat the last open C.. region (C after the last D) as the current command's slice
deviations.reason: observed on spark: nvsh context --show reported the previous command's output for ls /nope; thor/orin correct because nvsh owns OSC 133 there

deviations.what: v3/v8: doctor bindings_present is a false negative in a shell whose Enter macro just dispatched /doctor (all three machines), agent_reachable prints the backend's full endpoint URL, and the summary prints healthy while checks print FAIL; fix in nvsh/doctor_checks.py
deviations.reason: observed on spark, thor and orin at nvsh 0.9.2

deviations.what: v4: the hidden ' nvsh slash /doctor' dispatch exiting 1 (unhealthy) is treated as a qualifying failure and nvsh answers its own diagnostic with an agent turn; fix: the hook/trigger table never auto-triggers on nvsh's own hidden slash dispatch
v5: Ctrl+G prints the banner and discards the answer because readline.bash sends nvsh slash /ask to /dev/null; fix: run /ask against the tty after restoring readline
deviations.reason: observed on all three machines; the same /ask typed by hand streams a panel

deviations.what: v7: every cold session pays 'daemon connection lost: timed out' then a one-shot fallback on its first failure (spark, thor, orin), so the first answer runs outside the daemon; fix: the client waits for the autostarted daemon's socket to accept before giving up
deviations.reason: reproduced deliberately after nvsh daemon stop; not pi- or Ghostty-specific

deviations.what: v9: with pi, proposal.command carries the rendered panel text ('nvsh: run this command?\ncommand: ...') instead of the bare command, so Enter would run the wrong thing and the panel renders nested; fix in the pi adapter's proposal extraction
deviations.reason: confirmed in the audit log on spark
